Pack:      Roguelike Modern City pack
Author:    Kenney Vleugels, for Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
URL:       https://opengameart.org/content/roguelike-modern-city-pack
           (mirrors the original https://kenney.nl asset; OpenGameArt hosts a
           direct zip download, kenney.nl's own page for this exact pack has
           since been folded into the broader "Roguelike" asset line)
License:   CC0 1.0 Universal (Creative Commons Zero / public domain dedication)

Downloaded: 2026-09-20
Downloaded by: research task for FB-0025 (asset-pack survey)
Original zip: "Roguelike Modern City pack.zip" from
  https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/Roguelike%20Modern%20City%20pack.zip
Original zip sha256: ed45d3c0de24e821d71048fd665e3e238ccb49748c5cc520b43c751b39be93a5
Tile size: 16x16 px, 1px margin between tiles (see Spritesheet/spritesheetInfo.txt)
Contents kept here: Preview.png, Sample.png (mockup scenes from the author),
  Spritesheet/roguelikeCity_magenta.png (has a real alpha channel despite the
  filename -- use this one for compositing), Spritesheet/roguelikeCity_transparent.png
  (opaque RGB with a magenta background despite ITS filename -- the two files'
  names are swapped from what you'd expect; verified by decoding both PNGs'
  color type and alpha values during this research).
Covers: roads (multiple lane-marking styles), crosswalks, kerbs/sidewalks in three
  materials, parking-lot markings, traffic lights and signs, streetlamps, benches,
  planters, small building facades with windows/awnings, round trees and hedges/
  bushes (top-down canopy tiles), and a handful of top-down cars.
Does not cover: full 3/4-view buildings (these are pure top-down roof tiles, not
  a wall+roof view like this game's BITS buildings), interiors, or characters.
